name: fireguard-ltd
description: FireGuard LTD Fire Extinguisher Management System - Microservices

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:services: npm --prefix api-gateway install && npm --prefix auth-service install && npm --prefix user-service install && npm --prefix fire-extinguisher-service install && npm --prefix inspection-service install && npm --prefix maintenance-service install && npm --prefix notification-service install && npm --prefix reporting-service install
scripts.db:seed: npm --prefix auth-service run db:seed && npm --prefix fire-extinguisher-service run db:seed
scripts.db:generate: npm --prefix auth-service run db:generate && npm --prefix user-service run db:generate && npm --prefix fire-extinguisher-service run db:generate && npm --prefix inspection-service run db:generate && npm --prefix maintenance-service run db:generate && npm --prefix notification-service run db:generate
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run env:setup && npm run db:setup && npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,user,ext,insp,maint,notify,report,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red,white,gray,brightBlue "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:extinguisher" "npm run dev:inspection" "npm run dev:maintenance" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:reporting" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix api-gateway run build && npm --prefix auth-service run build && npm --prefix user-service run build && npm --prefix fire-extinguisher-service run build && npm --prefix inspection-service run build && npm --prefix maintenance-service run build && npm --prefix notification-service run build && npm --prefix reporting-service run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
